history.summary: A spam-titled FH 4BR penthouse in D05 at $3.49M / $2,268 psf with no URA series to verify pricing and a $3.5M quantum that sits in the thin end of the buyer pool. New (2027) and near Pasir Panjang MRT, but penthouse + high quantum + no data make it an Avoid for investment.
history.rating_rationale: $3.49M penthouse quantum is well above the liquid $1.8-2.5M band, and penthouses carry an illiquidity/resale-discount risk. With null URA appreciation and median data there is no transacted basis to confirm the $2,268 psf is fair, and the 'Cheap' marketing title flags promotional pricing rather than verified value. score_1000 467 is below market-typical.
